provenance.argument: QQ minors in each complete highest source give a lower bound on ideal dimension in the reduced nilcone. The proved orbit inclusion gives the opposite bound from the independent Higgs Hilbert series. The summed bounds coincide at every degree; no sampled zero is used to certify an image rank.

orbit_inclusion.argument: The G-saturation of this parabolic nilradical is the E6(a3) closure. Every monomial in grad I_d on the nilradical has grading at least 2(d-1)>12 for d=8,9,12; no such adjoint weight exists. Equivariance proves vanishing on the entire closure. Thus the proposed quotient surjects onto its coordinate ring.

paper_alignment.argument: A homogeneous generator f of degree d of N is represented with T=d-1. At polynomial degree e, products with k such generators have T<=e-k; conversely every presentation monomial with T<=s contains at least e-s graph factors. Therefore F_s R_e=(N^max(e-s,0))_e. Equality of generating ideals gives equality of these filtrations, and differentiation preserves T in both induced arc filtrations.
